name: Channels in Chats
author: wizard
description: Chats gets Activity and Channels tabs. Activity is a short what-needs-me list: Working, Ready (needs you and unread), Recent, then folded Snoozed and Archived, every agent's chats with each one's channel under its title, one sort and Undo after an archive (wizard-ux issue 1336); Channels shows your Spaces one per line (plus General), and opening one shows its chats as posts with a reply line. Slack-style, phase 1 (wizard-ux issue 1254). On a box with the Agent Service channel store, channels, pins, sort and archive are shared by every device, with Alerts pinned at the top (wizard-ux issue 1261). One switch for all of Channels (wizard-ux issue 1358): it also brings Needs you in the thread with Mark done, the channel read point shared by your devices, and on the Agent Service the channel store, first-message posts and agent filing, with no restart.
